title: Recipe 05: Dangerous actions and confirmation
summary: Archive actions require a human decision. Rejection leaves the record untouched; approval runs the business function once and records it.
summaryZh: 归档动作需要真人决定。拒绝时记录不变；允许时才执行一次业务函数并留下结果。

files.label: App.vue
files.role: Records, danger declarations, and result log
files.roleZh: 记录、危险声明与结果日志

guide.title: Put the final decision in front of a person
guide.titleZh: 把最终决定放到真人面前
intro: The model can request an archive, but it cannot approve itself.
Reject once, then allow once. The result log changes only on the allowed call.
introZh: 模型可以请求归档，但不能自我批准。
先拒绝一次，再允许一次。只有允许的调用会改变结果日志。

steps.title: Mark the risk
steps.body: The row action declares danger, so the execution policy requires a confirmation channel.
steps.bodyZh: 行内动作声明为 danger，执行策略因此要求确认通道。

steps.title: Use one write path
steps.body: The button and the assistant both call the same archive function; confirmation surrounds execution.
steps.bodyZh: 按钮与助手调用同一个归档函数；确认包裹在执行外层。

steps.title: Expose the result
steps.body: The page keeps a visible result log so a person can compare a rejected request with an executed one.
steps.bodyZh: 页面保留可见结果日志，便于对比拒绝请求与真正执行的请求。

guide.note: Ask the assistant to archive RPT-31. Reject the confirmation first; the row must stay ready. Repeat and allow it, then inspect the result log.
guide.noteZh: 让助手归档 RPT-31。先拒绝确认，记录必须仍为就绪；重复并允许后检查结果日志。
